entities.summary: Leader of Solomon Islands (2000–2001, 2006–2007, 2014, 2019–2024). Four-time PM; switched recognition to China 2019 (triggered riots 2021, Malaita opposition); authoritarian tendencies (delayed elections, Hong Kong-style foreign agents bill); Australian/US distrust;
